revise_description: To reflect differentiated handling options, each factory must be assigned to exactly one location and choose either standard or premium handling there. Premium handling has higher unit cost but a minimum handled volume share per factory-location if activated. Introduce binary assignment x[i,p] and mode y[i,p]; linearize choice so per-unit cost equals c_std[i,p]+(c_prem[i,p]-c_std[i,p])·y[i,p]. Enforce that premium mode implies handled volume share ≥ min_premium_share and total volume from a factory to its location equals its outbound volume. Objective minimizes total transportation+handling cost using d_ij and mode-specific costs.
